identity.affine_arithmetic: Arb encloses c0+exact_delta*v and alpha0+exact_delta*w before all fixed base weights
identity.parameter_arithmetic: First form complete exact center and direction scalar polynomials; then add the single p in [-eta,eta]. No independent raw-control parameter intervals are introduced.
identity.exact_delta_fraction_scope: The exact_delta_fraction field names the center only; all bounds cover the separately stated whole exact_parameter_interval.

actual_fourier_lattice: 4Z; physical theta period pi/2; Sobolev weights (1+16k^2)^(s/2)
physical_momentum: p=a*u_r+b*u_theta; full R46 frame includes T=(a*Lr+b*Ltheta)/2
actual_both_characteristic_branches: The paid branch and its exact theta reflection.

strong_remainder.exact_decomposition: C_strict=W0+R2, with the actual R46 W0 and actual h_sigma, S_sigma

ordinary_source.output: E_s in the actual full R46 frame

actual_scalar_knot_regularity.implication: The actual infinite primitive is globally C4 in r with all paid angular derivatives; the fixed-type coefficients are C2 and piecewise W3,infinity, so the WKB conormal has no knot delta source.

limitations: Only the exact displayed closed negative interval is included.
The tiny negative canonical collar is not identified with this interval's physical endpoints.
The large complete constants are not advertised as an effective final high inverse.
No weak divergence-source load has been silently converted into an ordinary source.
